IGUI_ST_OptRods_tt: How many rods THOR-1 can drop in one strike window. Once they are spent it moves off station.
IGUI_ST_OptRadius_tt: Every infected within this distance of the impact dies. The shockwave kills most of them up to 50 tiles further and knocks down the rest up to 70 tiles further. Only the area the game keeps loaded around you can be hit.
IGUI_ST_OptReach_tt: How far from you the rod can be marked. Past about 50 tiles the game has not loaded the ground yet: the strike still lands there, and the infected and buildings in it are dealt with as soon as that ground loads. The sensor map shows this range as a ring round you.
IGUI_ST_OptIndoor_tt: The rod and its shockwave kill the infected inside buildings too, on every floor. Off: only those outdoors, as the other strikes do.
IGUI_ST_OptNoise_tt: How far away the impact draws the infected towards it. 0: it draws none.
IGUI_ST_OptFlattenRadius_tt: With the main mod's "Strikes leave craters" option on, the rod levels everything built this far from the impact: walls, doors, windows, furniture and the floors above the ground go, and the ground is left burnt. A lasting change to the map. A mark this close to you (plus 3 tiles) is refused.
IGUI_ST_OptShake_tt: How hard your view shakes when the rod lands (stronger the closer you are). 0 turns it off, 1 is the default. Needs the Viewpoint Edition of Skyhammer.
IGUI_ST_OptFire_tt: The impact sets a few fires inside the blast area. Buildings can burn down.
IGUI_ST_OptCinematic_tt: From "rod away": Asgard's view from orbit, then in Viewpoint's 3D view the camera rides the rod down onto the target and cuts back to you on the impact. In the plain view, the orbit alone. A click skips it.
IGUI_SH_Info1_thor: Asgard, the orbital station, moves its weapon satellite THOR-1 over your grid and drops a tungsten rod from orbit onto the point you mark. Hammer Actual has to authorize every release.
IGUI_SH_Info2_thor: Everything within the kill radius dies, indoors too, and the shockwave knocks down what lies beyond. One rod a sortie unless Mod Options say otherwise, and a long wait to rearm.
IGUI_ST_Hint_Inbound: THOR-1 is moving into position over your grid.
IGUI_ST_Hint_Window: Mark the impact point on the map or eyes-on. Everything within %1 tiles dies. Rods left: %2.
IGUI_ST_Hint_Auth: Hammer Actual is authorizing the release.
IGUI_ST_Hint_Falling: Rod inbound. Impact in %1 seconds. Stay clear.
